name: Elegant Marbles and Grani Industries Limited
about: Elegant Marbles and Grani Industries Limited manufactures and trades in marbles, and other stones tiles and slabs in India. The company offers gemstones, travertine, and quartz stone slabs, as well as onyx and crystal onyx. Elegant Marbles and Grani Industries Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.
